title: Zoro Select 11-Inch Non-Sparking Offset Drum Bung Wrench (Fits 3/4" & 2" Bungs)
description: When you need to work with drums and barrels, the Zoro Select 8-805 Drum Bung Wrench is the tool for the job. The offset handle provides excellent leverage and control. This drum bung wrench fits 3/4 in and 2 in bungs, as well as a 4-bung pattern. The non-sparking design makes it safe to use around flammable liquids such as gasoline or kerosene. It also has an overall length of 11 in., which gives you plenty of room to manoeuvre this tool around fasteners. When it comes to working with drums and barrels, having the Zoro Select 8-805 Drum Bung Wrench on hand will make your job easier.
